originalLine: 接天莲叶无穷碧，映日荷花别样红。
originalLineEn: Lotus leaves stretch green to the sky; lotus flowers glow unusually red in the sun.
source: 杨万里《晓出净慈寺送林子方》
sourceEn: Yang Wanli, Dawn at Jingci Temple

line: 接天莲叶无穷碧，映日红包别样红。
lineEn: Lotus leaves stretch green to the sky; red packets glow unusually red in the sun.
originalLine: 接天莲叶无穷碧，映日荷花别样红。
originalLineEn: Lotus leaves stretch green to the sky; lotus flowers glow unusually red in the sun.
source: 杨万里《晓出净慈寺送林子方》
sourceEn: Yang Wanli, Dawn at Jingci Temple

line: 春色满园关不住，一枝红杏出墙来。
lineEn: The garden can't hold in all its spring; a red apricot branch reaches over the wall.
originalLine: 春色满园关不住，一枝红杏出墙来。
originalLineEn: The garden can't hold in all its spring; a red apricot branch reaches over the wall.
sourceEn: Ye Shaoweng, Visiting a Garden in Vain

line: 春色满园关不住，一根网线出墙来。

originalLine: 春色满园关不住，一枝红杏出墙来。

line: 君问归期未有期，巴山夜雨涨秋池。
lineEn: You ask when I'll return; I can't say. Night rain in Bashan fills the autumn pools.
originalLine: 君问归期未有期，巴山夜雨涨秋池。
originalLineEn: You ask when I'll return; I can't say. Night rain in Bashan fills the autumn pools.
sourceEn: Li Shangyin, Night Rain, Sent North

line: 君问归期未有期，项目还要加班改。

line: 春风又绿江南岸，明月何时照我还。
lineEn: Spring wind greens the south bank again; when will the moon light my way home?
originalLine: 春风又绿江南岸，明月何时照我还。
originalLineEn: Spring wind greens the south bank again; when will the moon light my way home?
sourceEn: Wang Anshi, Mooring at Guazhou

line: 春风又绿江南岸，快递何时到我家。
lineEn: Spring wind greens the south bank again; when will my parcel reach my home?
originalLine: 春风又绿江南岸，明月何时照我还。
originalLineEn: Spring wind greens the south bank again; when will the moon light my way home?
sourceEn: Wang Anshi, Mooring at Guazhou

line: 等闲识得东风面，万紫千红总是春。
lineEn: Anyone can know the face of the east wind; a riot of colours is always spring.
originalLine: 等闲识得东风面，万紫千红总是春。
originalLineEn: Anyone can know the face of the east wind; a riot of colours is always spring.
